items.title: Teenager charged with murder after fatal shooting
items.summary: A 17-year-old was arrested in Richardson and charged with murder and aggravated assault after a shooting that killed one person and left another hospitalised in stable condition.

items.title: Boy injured in hit-and-run; police seek dashcam footage
items.summary: A boy was hurt when a truck struck him and drove off. Investigators are asking witnesses and drivers with dashcam footage to come forward to help identify the vehicle.

items.title: Five-year-old dies after being left in a hot car
items.summary: A five-year-old girl died after being left in a vehicle outside her home during extreme heat. Her family told detectives it took some time to realise she was still in the car. No charges have been filed.

items.title: Man killed by driver during attempted carjacking
items.summary: A man died after being shot by a driver during what police described as an attempted carjacking. Police said he was unarmed. No other injuries were reported.
